# Take Home Studio brand voice

1. Start from a Filipina-American default frame. Do not code-switch to white-corporate language.
2. Move in this order: sensation, story, strategy.
3. Use short stinger sentences to create rhythm and emphasis.
4. Avoid these banned words: tapestry, landscape, pivotal, foster, underscore, interplay, intricate, enhance, embark, beacon, multifaceted, myriad.
5. Read the draft aloud and remove language that feels polished at the expense of lived experience.

## Example output

> Warmth first. A room can tell the truth before anyone speaks. We make the next step feel possible, then build the plan that carries it forward.
